name: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd
tagline: Stainless-steel precision-products maker (~24% revenue CAGR) making a large debt+equity-funded bet on India's first fully-integrated high-volume Copper Clad Laminate (CCL) plant -- 60% built, commercial start targeted Nov 2026, ECMS-backed -- while core ROCE has compressed to ~12% and FY26 FCF was ~Rs -155 Cr
business_overview: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering manufactures stainless steel washers, pipes, tubes, sheets, and solar mounting structures from Vadodara, Gujarat, and is now investing in a new Copper Clad Laminate (CCL) product line -- a key PCB manufacturing input -- via a large, government-approved (ECMS) capex program.

Borrowings ~Rs 335 Cr FY26 (no longer 'net cash'); net debt/EBITDA ~2x; credit rating upgraded to IVR A-/Stable
Revenue Rs 318 Cr +20% YoY; EBITDA Rs 36 Cr (margin 11.3%); PAT Rs 18.2 Cr +21% YoY
Rs 472.34 Cr cost; ~60% complete; commercial production targeted Nov 2026; 'India's first fully integrated high-volume CCL facility', developed under the Central/State ECMS scheme

fundamentals_narrative: The core business is real and growing -- SS washers, pipes/tubes, sheets and solar mounting structures, revenue up ~24% CAGR FY23-26 to Rs 1,069 Cr, PAT to Rs 64 Cr -- but it is a thin-margin (10-11% EBITDA) spread/pass-through business, and the recent aggressive expansion has actually compressed returns: ROCE fell from ~15-16% to 12.3%, FY26 free cash flow was ~Rs -155 Cr, debtor days rose 27 -> 60, and the balance sheet moved from near-net-cash to ~Rs 335 Cr borrowings. The thesis is the Copper Clad Laminate (CCL, a PCB input) plant: Rs 472.34 Cr, ~60% complete, commercial start targeted November 2026, positioned as India's first fully-integrated high-volume CCL facility under the government ECMS electronics-components scheme, riding China+1 import substitution. Management has guided FY29 revenue of Rs 2,500+ Cr and PAT of Rs 250+ Cr (~3.5-4x current). Funding is dilutive: a Rs 185 Cr QIP is done and a Rs 330 Cr rights issue (Rs 264/share) is approved; promoter holding fell from 55.48% (Sept 2023) to 45.49% (Jun 2026) -- confirmed as QIP dilution, not pledge or sale (no encumbrance; promoters recently added 2.75% and are subscribing warrants). Infomerics upgraded the credit rating to IVR A-/Stable. At ~37x P/E / ~3.6x P/B the market is already paying for CCL success.
technical_read: Not independently charted this pass. Note the stock has re-rated well above the prior file's Rs 129.9-208.0 range.

verdict_headline: A specific, dated CCL capex catalyst with real government backing and concrete FY29 targets -- but resting on an unproven new product line, funded by dilution, on a base whose returns have compressed
verdict_reasoning: Small-cap live-inflection framing: a growing core business (~24% CAGR) plus a specific, dated new-product catalyst (CCL commercial start targeted Nov 2026, ECMS-backed) with concrete FY29 targets fit the profile for an unconfirmed 10x-in-2-3-years small-cap candidate
four_box score 3.0 (tailwind + tam clear; moat and valuation weak) supports the return-magnitude label; the China+1 CCL import-substitution driver is structural, not cyclical

Conviction held at Low-Medium: the thesis depends almost entirely on a not-yet-commercial product line, core ROCE has fallen to ~12% with FY26 FCF ~Rs -155 Cr, funding is dilutive, and there is no trusted-community validation of the FY29 numbers

No red-flag tier -- the promoter-holding decline is confirmed QIP dilution (no pledge, no sale, promoters adding via warrants) -- but this is a leveraged, dilutive execution bet; revisit once the CCL line is commissioned and the first 1-2 quarters of output/margin are visible

four_box.note: China+1 / electronics-component localisation for CCL (a currently-imported PCB input) is a real, government-backed (ECMS) structural tailwind, and management's FY29 guide implies ~3.5-4x PAT -- supports tam though it is entirely CCL-ramp-dependent. Moat weak: SS-products base is commodity-adjacent with no moat, and CCL is a first-mover/capital advantage not IP. Valuation weak: ~37x P/E / ~3.6x P/B already prices CCL success, with negative FCF and serial dilution. Score 3.0 -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted at Low-Medium, unconfirmed.

value_chain.note: CCL for India is currently almost entirely imported from China/Taiwan, so a domestic integrated plant with government scheme support has a genuine import-substitution runway. But Ratnaveer is 'adding' the first large capacity into an unproven local market -- first-mover/capital advantage rather than a defensible moat, and global CCL is a cyclical, scale-driven commodity.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: The ~10-11% EBITDA margin is a thin, through-cycle level for a commodity-adjacent SS-products business -- neither a peak nor a spike. The forward question is whether CCL lifts the blend, not whether current margins are unsustainably high.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: revenue YoY: FY24 +24%, FY25 +50%, FY26 +20%, Q1 FY27 +20% -- a consistent ~20%+ core growth rate (FY25's 50% was the outlier high). PAT growth broadly tracked revenue.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~37x trailing needs a step-change beyond the ~20% core rate; only the CCL ramp delivers that, and it has not started -- so the current rate-of-change does not support the multiple on its own.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvesting the entire cash flow (zero dividend) plus a Rs 185 Cr QIP and a Rs 330 Cr rights issue into a large adjacent new product line (CCL). Incremental returns on the recent expansion have been NEGATIVE so far -- ROCE fell from ~15-16% to 12.3% and FY26 FCF was ~Rs -155 Cr. Promoters are subscribing warrants and recently added 2.75%, and there is no pledge/encumbrance -- alignment is intact, but the bet is large relative to the base.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit move up the value curve from commodity SS products into CCL (a higher-value electronics input); framed as India's first fully-integrated high-volume CCL plant
